batch.productContext: The client is launching a consumer mobile app that takes and tracks water-quality readings, sold direct to the public through app stores, with online training services bundled alongside it.

marks.name: VENQORI
marks.classesPlain: downloadable software for water-quality monitoring, mobile apps (9); software-as-a-service and technical/scientific water-testing and analysis services (42); online training and educational services (41); retail and app-store distribution of downloadable software (35, belt-and-braces)
marks.contextFraming: VENQORI is the consumer-facing house and product name for the water-quality monitoring app itself and for the online training bundled with it — the name on the app-store listing and the whole offering, not a feature, tier or sub-brand within a larger line; as a string it is coined and dictionary-empty, a made-up Latinate-sounding compound with no water, testing or environmental meaning to borrow from, so it should be read as a fanciful mark whose risk sits in phonetic and visual neighbours rather than in shared descriptive wording.
